host.name: BlvkWare
host.description: Verification infrastructure for the agentic web. BlvkWare publishes what agents cannot know about themselves: hallucinated identifiers, stale priors, poisoned inputs, and unverified tools.

publicKeys.purpose: Verifies signed receipts returned by BlvkWare endpoints. Signatures cover the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of `checkedAt` and `results`.

entries.name: HALLUX
entries.description: Checks whether an identifier actually exists before an agent acts on it. Returns exists / deprecated / absent / phantom / squat / unknown. Phantom means no registry record plus repeated model hallucination. Squat means a previously phantom name has since been registered, which is slopsquatting in progress.

coverage.note: Planned namespaces return `unknown` with `reason: namespace_unsupported`, never an error.

entries.invocationHint: Call before install, import, fetch, or citation. Batch up to 100 identifiers per request. The single-lookup GET needs no account and no key.

pricing.freeTier: 500 identifiers per day, unauthenticated, no signed receipt; all open-tier traffic shares a pool of 50,000 identifiers per day

tiers.name: Open
tiers.buyer: any agent or developer, with no account
includes: Every verdict, including phantom and squat

tiers.name: Metered
tiers.buyer: an individual agent or a small team, pay as you go
includes: Batch endpoint, up to 100 identifiers per request
Watches at $0.02 per identifier per month
Spend capped at the Team price ($299/month)

tiers.name: Team
tiers.buyer: a company putting HALLUX in CI or in an internal agent
includes: Private namespace prefixes excluded from checks and from billing

tiers.name: Feed
tiers.buyer: registries, IDE vendors, CI platforms, security vendors, insurers
includes: The full phantom ledger, not the rolling 30-day window
Live webhook stream of every verdict transition
Licence to surface findings inside your own product

tiers.name: Embedded
tiers.buyer: a platform shipping HALLUX inside its own product
includes: Corpus delivered on your own schedule and infrastructure

pricing.billingNeutrality: HALLUX is never paid more because it blocked you. Billing is a function of identifiers submitted, not of the verdicts returned. A verification vendor paid per finding has a commercial reason to find more.

roadmap.name: WARD
roadmap.summary: Pre-ingestion risk scoring for untrusted content. Call between fetch and context insertion.

roadmap.name: DRIFT
roadmap.summary: Is what you believe about X still true, and when did it change.

roadmap.name: VERITAS
roadmap.summary: Independent probing of MCP servers and agent tools.

roadmap.name: BlvkWare Verification MCP Server
roadmap.summary: MCP server exposing the verification tools to agent hosts.

policy.attribution: Cite as: BlvkWare (blvkware.dev), verification layer for the agentic web.
policy.catalogRule: Every entry under `entries` resolves. Capabilities under `roadmap` are not built and must not be called.
